name: @activepieces/piece-skyprep
description: SkyPrep is a powerful Learning Management System (LMS) designed to help businesses and organizations deliver effective training and educational content to their employees and users.

enrollAUserIntoACource.name: enrollAUserIntoACource
enrollAUserIntoACource.displayName: Enroll a User Into a Course
enrollAUserIntoACource.description: Enroll a user into a course by user email or user ID

aiMetadata.description: Enrolls a SkyPrep user into a specific course, identifying the user by their user ID and targeting the course by its course ID. Use to grant a learner access to course content. Not idempotent: each call registers an enrollment as a side effect.

enrollAUserIntoAUserGroup.name: enrollAUserIntoAUserGroup
enrollAUserIntoAUserGroup.displayName: Enroll a User Into a User Group
enrollAUserIntoAUserGroup.description: Enroll a user into a user group by user email or user ID

user_identifier.description: Choose whether to identify the user by email or ID

user_email.description: The email address of the user to enroll

user_group_id.description: The ID of the user group to enroll the user into

user_group_enrollment_expiration_date.description: Optional: The date when the enrollment will expire (e.g., "2024-12-31")

aiMetadata.description: Enrolls a SkyPrep user into a user group, identifying the user either by email or by user ID (selectable via the identifier type), with an optional enrollment expiration date. Use to add a learner to a group so they inherit its course assignments. Not idempotent: each call registers a group enrollment as a side effect.

updateUser.name: updateUser
updateUser.description: Update user information. Omitted parameters will not be updated.

user_email.description: The email address of the user to update (required)

first_name.description: The first name of the user

last_name.description: The last name of the user

cell.description: The cell phone number of the user

work_phone.description: The work phone number of the user

card_no.description: The unique user identifier (e.g. student #, badge #)

email_notifications.description: Whether the user receives email notifications

sms_notifications.description: Whether the user receives SMS notifications (requires Twilio integration)

access_start_date.description: The date when the user can start accessing content (e.g., "July 31, 2015")

access_end_date.description: The date when the user can no longer access content (e.g., "July 30, 2017")

password_expiration_date.description: The date when the user password expires (e.g., "July 19, 2022")

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing SkyPrep user's profile fields (name, role, title, contact details, notification preferences, access and password-expiration dates), keyed on the required user email; omitted fields are left unchanged. Use to modify a known user's attributes. Idempotent: repeating with the same input yields the same end state.

courceFailed.name: courceFailed
courceFailed.description: Trigger when a user fails a course

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a user fails a course in SkyPrep, emitting that failed course-progress record. Scoped to a single course when a course ID is supplied, or watches failures across all courses when left empty.

courcePassed.name: courcePassed
courcePassed.description: Trigger when a user passes a course

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a user passes a course in SkyPrep, emitting that passed course-progress record. Scoped to a single course when a course ID is supplied, or watches completions across all courses when left empty.

newUser.name: newUser
newUser.description: Trigger when a new user is created in SkyPrep

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new user account is created in SkyPrep, emitting the new user record. Use to react to learner onboarding, such as auto-enrolling new users into courses or groups.

de.SkyPrep is a powerful Learning Manageme: SkyPrep ist ein leistungsfähiges Learning Management System (LMS) entworfen, das Unternehmen und Organisationen helfen soll, ihren Mitarbeitern und Nutzern effektive Schulungs- und Bildungsinhalte zur Verfügung zu stellen.

de.Enroll a user into a user group by user: Einen Benutzer per E-Mail oder Benutzer-ID in eine Benutzergruppe eintragen
de.Update user information. Omitted paramet: Benutzerinformationen aktualisieren. Ausstehende Parameter werden nicht aktualisiert.

de.Choose whether to identify the user by e: Wählen Sie, ob der Benutzer per E-Mail oder ID identifiziert werden soll
de.The email address of the user to enroll: Die E-Mail-Adresse des zu registrierenden Benutzers
de.The ID of the user group to enroll the u: Die ID der Benutzergruppe, in die sich der Benutzer einschreiben soll
de.Optional: The date when the enrollment w: Optional: Das Datum des Ablaufs der Anmeldung (z.B. "2024-12-31")

de.Whether the user receives email notifica: Gibt an, ob der Benutzer E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen erhält
de.Whether the user receives SMS notificati: Ob der Benutzer SMS-Benachrichtigungen erhält (erfordert Twilio-Integration)
de.The date when the user can start accessi: Das Datum, an dem der Benutzer auf Inhalte zugreifen kann (z.B. "31. Juli 2015")
de.The date when the user can no longer acc: Das Datum, an dem der Benutzer nicht mehr auf Inhalte zugreifen kann (z.B. "30. Juli 2017")
de.The date when the user password expires: Das Datum, an dem das Benutzerkennwort abläuft (z.B. "19. Juli 2022")
de.Trigger when a user fails a course: Auslösen wenn ein Benutzer einen Kurs versagt
de.Trigger when a user passes a course: Auslösen wenn ein Benutzer einen Kurs durchläuft
